### 1. Scene
A breakfast tray with sliced seeded bread, a toasted crumpet or English muffin, cereal, a sweet muffin, individual spreads, and milk. Water contributes no energy.

### 2. Vessels
- Main plate: approximately **24 cm diameter**, area **452 cm²**.
- Cereal bowl: approximately **17 cm diameter**, area **227 cm²**.
- The muffin and spread portions sit separately on the same tray, so I include them.

### 3–7. Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
Area percentages below refer to each item’s own vessel. For items outside a vessel, I estimate their footprint directly.

| Item | Area coverage | Gross volume calculation | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Seeded bread, approximately three slices | 35% of plate = 158 cm² | 158 × 2.2 cm = 348 ml | 0.30 | 104 | 260 | 270 kcal |
| Toasted crumpet/English muffin | 16% = 72 cm² | 72 × 1.3 cm = 94 ml | 0.65 | 61 | 230 | 140 kcal |
| Visible melted butter | Thin layer on toasted item; overlaps its footprint | Approximately 5 ml | 0.95 | 5 | 720 | 36 kcal |
| Cornflakes | 31% of bowl = 70 cm² | 70 × 2 cm = 140 ml | 0.18 | 25 | 375 | 94 kcal |
| Almond-topped sweet muffin | Approximately 65 cm² footprint | 65 × 4.5 cm = 293 ml | 0.30 | 88 | 400 | 352 kcal |
| Two packaged spreads, assumed butter | Approximately 20 cm² combined | 20 × 1 cm = 20 ml | 0.95 | 19 | 720 | 137 kcal |
| Milk in bottle | Not applicable | Approximately 180 ml visible | 1.03 | 185 | 50 | 93 kcal |

### 8. Sanity check
The main plate is approximately **51% covered**, with the bread stacked. The cereal is a small, shallow portion. The estimated total is **487 g and 1,122 kcal**, excluding water and packaging. The spread identity and bread slice count are the largest uncertainties.
